title: The Chain Gang
text: Souls chained together haul stone up the Pit's wall, step by bleeding step, while an imp walks the line with a whip. None of them look up until one does. It begs you for help in your own House's tongue.

options.label: The strongest breaks their chain, whatever the Pit may think of it.

outcomes.text: The freed souls scatter like smoke. The one who begged leaves you something it hid, though something below takes note of what you did.
The imp screams for its masters. They come.

options.label: The shrewdest bribes the imp to let the one who begged go free.

outcomes.text: With a sneer it lets the one go, keeping your gold. You hope the soul gets far.

options.label: Look away and keep walking. You cannot save every soul in the Pit.

outcomes.text: The voice follows you down, begging in your own House's tongue, until you cannot tell it from your own thoughts.
